notes.title: Gameplay Update
notes.content: Adjustments based on player feedback are ongoing. With this update, taking damage from all enemies in the game will no longer result in knockback. Players will now have greater freedom of movement. Additionally, all sections of the game containing deadly spikes have been reworked, with new platforms added to these areas. Players will no longer be forced to die due to a last-second jump or an enemy encountered mid-air. Enemy health and the damage they deal have also been updated.

notes.title: Penalty System Update
notes.content: Some of our players were not happy with the mechanic that caused them to lose all their Caossouls upon death. Based on their feedback, we've made changes to this system. Now, when a player dies in any way, they no longer lose all of their Caossouls. The amount lost now depends on how many Caossouls the player has, and if the amount is small, there is no loss at all. With this change, we aim to make the penalty system feel fairer and more balanced for players.

notes.title: Omen Fall Has Been Reforged
notes.content:
The first major update for Omen Fall is here – the Aytol (Act 1) chapter is now playable!

So, what’s new?

* All artwork has been completely redesigned.
* Core gameplay mechanics have been improved for smoother action.
* Level design has been fully revamped.
* Abilities have been reworked.
* The story and dialogues have been rewritten.
* The soundtrack has been updated.
* Environmental design has been enhanced.
* Controller support has been added.
* Menus and UI have been completely redesigned.
* In-game menus are now available.
* Steam achievements have been added.
* A map system is now integrated.
* Enemy behavior has been made more consistent.
* Boss fights have been fully redesigned.
* Screen resolution options have been added.
* The reward and penalty system has been overhauled.
* Sound and visual effects have been updated.
* New NPCs have been added.

Note: Future expansions are planned and will be released for free to all owners of the game.
